Title: Create a new order with making charge for measurement groups and verify it is stored and returned in the response
Preconditions: A shop and customer exist in the system. At least one item is available for order.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order created successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<string order ID>", "totalAmount": 700.50, "dueAmount": 200.50, "paidAmount": 500}}. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the measurement group with "makingCharge": 200.50.

Title: Update an existing order with a new making charge for measurement groups and verify it is updated in the response
Preconditions: An existing order with at least one measurement group exists in the system.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order updated successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<string order ID>", "totalAmount": 900.75, "dueAmount": 300.75, "paidAmount": 600}}. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the measurement group with "makingCharge": 300.75.

Title: Verify that error messages include detailed exception information when an unexpected error occurs
Preconditions: A scenario exists where an unexpected error can be triggered (e.g., invalid base64 image data).
Expected Result: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "error", "message": "An unexpected error occurred:Illegal base64 character"}.

Title: Create a new order and verify that the 'urgent' flag is no longer present in the response
Preconditions: A shop and customer exist in the system. At least one item is available for order.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body not containing the field 'urgent' at the order level. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body not containing the field 'urgent' in any measurement group.

Title: Create a new order without specifying total, paid, or due amounts and verify default values are set
Preconditions: A shop and customer exist in the system. At least one item is available for order.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order created successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<string order ID>", "totalAmount": 200.50, "dueAmount": 200.50, "paidAmount": 0}}.
